description: R, Python and shell scripts reproduce research mapping human wastewater inputs and impacts on coastal ecosystems, with a separate final-data repository. This resource is provided by OHI-Science (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: GPL-3.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The computational workflow supports one publication; final datasets should not be conflated with this code repository. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
